Good catch!

When a component is generated (as instructed in a previous step), it comes with the `OnInit` interface and empty `constructor()` and `ngOnInit()` method. Since they are not used in this examples, they are "silently" removed (thus the latesr snippet does not include the `imlements OnInit` part.

We should either keep them or explicitly mention in the guide that they can be removed, since they are not used in this component.

The example does not work…..
best idea would be to  implement a fix to get it working …….

I'll leave it to the docs team to decide :wink:
It depends on what is done in other similar cases in the docs.

I followed the tutorial exactly adding & removing items...
then when I got to that stage the messages did not display.... on the button click..

Wanted to throw it to some students, but thought i should check it first.....

@ajitsinghkaler a note might be good explaining what @gkalpak said [here](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/34562#issuecomment-569490453) or that they are unused in the current example. We do often have snippets without all the code from the class in them saying something like "x removed for brevity" or clarity, etc.

@Hardcore-fs could you share a stackblitz of your issue? If we could look at the code, maybe something would stand out.

issue.title: docs: add note that why ngOnInit not used
